Computers in Human Behavior: Artificial Humans, 1(2), 100014. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.chbah.2023.100014 — short version and further validation: Koch, M. J., Carolus, A., Wienrich, C., & Latoschik, M. E. (2024). Meta AI literacy scale: Further validation and development of a short version. Heliyon, 10(21), e39686. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.heliyon.2024.e39686

stdyInfo.abstract: Self-report scale of AI literacy with 34 items rated from 0 to 10. Besides the AI literacy facets use and apply, know and understand, detect AI, AI ethics and create AI, it covers AI self-efficacy (problem solving, learning) and AI self-competency (persuasion literacy, emotion regulation). It was developed with German-speaking adults and is published in German and English; a 10-item short version (Koch et al., 2024) reuses items of the long version.

useStmt.conditions: Questionnaire PDFs published by the authors at https://hci.uni-wuerzburg.de/research/MAILS/ without a license statement. The items are also printed in the article (Appendix A), which is "an open access article under the CC BY-NC-ND license (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/)", and in the arXiv preprint (arXiv:2302.09319) under CC BY 4.0. Cite Carolus et al. (2023).
